name: Open porch with the save-the-date frame
image_prompt:
A full-bleed portrait 9:16 frame of a richly cinematic dimensional storybook-animation mosque-courtyard wedding invitation. Soft romantic late-2000s South Indian cinema mood: dreamy natural light, intimate coastal Kerala atmosphere, gentle teal-and-warm contrast, quiet emotional longing. Soft cream and powder-blue palette with pearl highlights, pale pink florals and cool backwaters haze beyond coconut palms. Cream and gold plaster arches, laterite stone accents, one dome, one courtyard pool, and palms. Premium animated adult characters with sculpted expressive faces, never photographic people. DRAMATIC CHIAROSCURO: gentle warm back-and-side sunlight streams diagonally through arched openings and open porch bays, clearly visible soft volumetric god rays cutting through thin coastal atmospheric haze; luminous rim light on cream silk, lace, pearl and champagne-gold frames against cooler powder-blue shade. Preserve readable highlights, not a flat uniformly bright wash. Very fine dust motes sparkle only inside the sunbeams. Floor is subtly reflective worn cream stone or polished laterite tile, not a mirror. Gold lettering has illuminated beveled edges, warm restrained emissive bloom, luminous hairline flourishes and discrete pinpoint highlights; sharp readable counters. Fixed floral wedding décor of white jasmine, soft pink roses, baby's breath and green foliage — not marigold temple swags as primary. Roughly 12 to 20 tiny separate white, soft-pink and cream petals already scattered irregularly through the whole depth volume: a few soft near-lens edge petals, crisp midground petals, tiny distant petals. No confetti cannon, solid flower bunches in the air, symmetrical particle rows or dense shower from one point. All bouquets and garlands are fixed to their supports. Generate only from this text, no reference image. No watermark, interface, duplicate people, extra signs or unintended words.

ONE cream-and-gold mosque-courtyard wedding compound with ONE dome at the far end of its central axis, near hazy backwaters and coconut palms, and ONE rectangular courtyard pool. In front of the pool is ONE much smaller freestanding open arched porch, with four cream plaster corner columns, a shallow tiled roof, soft floral scallops of white jasmine and pale pink roses, and three shallow front steps. All four sides of the porch are OPEN BETWEEN THE ARCHES, including the rear: clear daylight and the distant single dome are visible through the rear gaps from a frontal low viewpoint. There is no masonry rear wall, inner box, door panel or nested doorway. A single wooden picture frame stands on a low table between two soft candle stands. Keep the roof, corner columns, steps, table and rear opening physically consistent. The dome remains outside beyond the rear arches. The open left side connects directly to the adjacent side-courtyard bay.

SHOT: Eye-level camera inside the SAME small open arched porch, facing the wooden picture frame and the distant dome beyond the open rear side. Two front columns frame the extreme edges, rear columns are visible farther away, and a shallow roof with a floral beam sits overhead. Daylight remains visible on both sides of the table, continuing into the exterior courtyard behind it. The wooden picture frame, cream mat and gold inner bevel together occupy approximately 40 percent of image height in the lower middle, with polished foreground floor still visible. Inside the frame, ornate gold display lettering reads exactly 'Save the Date - [DATE]'. Exquisite curved serifs, a gently arched first line, elegant varied stroke widths and modest flourishes. The lettering spans most of the frame interior, fully inside the wood border, with luminous champagne-gold faces, antique-gold beveled edges, subtle warm halos and tiny bright edge glints. Rich gold, not brown engraving. No second plaque, no printed wall text and no letters floating outside the frame. Readable counters and gaps between words. Soft sunrise strikes the frame obliquely and reflects softly in the polished cream stone. Abundant individual white jasmine and soft pink rose petals in three depths: softly defocused small near-lens petals at the edges, sharp midground petals and tiny background petals. Keep the lettering unobscured. A few delicate soft candle wisps originate ONLY at a visible low candle stand; the lettering emits no smoke. Leave the left-side exit open and visible. This is one facet of the SAME cream-and-gold mosque-courtyard wedding compound: one dome, one courtyard pool, palms, arched arcades. Any person present holds a still pose. The camera does not walk them.
